title: Sunset Labs — token behavior & deployment playbook (scratch)
content:
Meeting capture (quick, messy)

Attendees: Ethan (Redwood SE), Maya (Redwood Solutions PM), Ravi (Sunset Labs - infra), Lena (Sunset Labs - ML), Tom (Sunset - product). 45m sync 2025-02-10.

Primary ask: move from prototype (open-hosted) -> private deployment in their GCP project with strict PII controls, predictable latency (p50 < 150ms for short queries) and cost target (~$0.006 per inference on average). They care about token burn—worst case prompt bloat has spiked cost.

Constraints / notes from customer:
- Data: user messages include short form IDs and medical codes; cannot leave raw logs in managed plane. Must use customer KMS/HSM and log-filtering.
- Network: VPC peering required; no internet egress from inference nodes.
- Throughput: baseline 30 req/s concurrent, burst to 120 req/s for 60s windows.
- Context: often 4–8 turns, 2–4KB history; average synth token length ~120, tail 800 tokens occasionally.
- Safety: hallucination on codes unacceptable. Need guardrails and deterministic rerank for templates.

Gotchas we observed / call observations:
- Tokenization: large numeric IDs broken into many tokens; they embed long JSON fragments in prompts. Recommend canonicalizing IDs to shortcode before sending.
- Prompt drift: product team appends long internal notes to user context on every turn — exploding prefix.
- KV cache reuse: their session IDs are long-lived but turn length varies; we should use prefix caching on fixed system content and prune user-supplied free text.
- Autoscale & cold-start: burst profile of 120 req/s with 1–2s startup spikes will need reserved burst capacity (Dedicated) or pre-warming hooks in Private deployment.

Immediate technical recommendations (what to do now):
- Prompt hygiene policy: add a lightweight rewrite layer (at edge) that replaces full GUIDs with 8-char stable tokens and strips debug payloads. Pseudocode below:
  - input = redactIds(raw_input)
  - input = trimDebugSections(input, max_bytes=600)
  - prompt = attachSystemTemplate(input)
- Model selection: start with a 7B quantized int8 variant (good perf/cost) and have a 13B float fallback for high-quality code/medical reasoning. Configure automatic fallback policy by token budget + latency.
- Serving config recommendations:
  - prefix_cache: enabled for system+static context
  - batching: target latency 40ms, batch size cap 16 (tune after load test)
  - kv_cache_ttl: 30m for session metadata, flush on sensitive label
  - quant_profile: int8-quant recommended; evaluate quality on unit prompt set (see linked eval ticket)
- Observability & safety:
  - add token-level metrics: per-field token burn (system vs user vs assistant) in Console
  - register eval set for hallucination checks; wire alerts for >1% regression on medical code recall

Operational ask for Sunset Labs team (what we need from them):
- Sample dataset: 500 real (sanitized) conversations + 200 edge cases with very long IDs by 2025-02-17.
- Access: GCP project details + IAM contact for VPC peering and KMS setup.
- SLA target confirmation: are they comfortable with p50<150ms and p95<500ms? Need sign-off.

Next steps / owners / deadlines (rough):
- SE: prepare configuration draft for Private deployment (Ethan) — target 2025-02-14.
- Solutions PM: draft business case for Dedicated vs Private cost run (Maya) — target 2025-02-18.
- Customer infra: provide GCP project + KMS handshake (Ravi) — target 2025-02-16.
- ML: compile unit eval prompt set (Lena) and annotate hallucination-critical examples — target 2025-02-17.
- Shared: schedule 60m load test planning call to design burst pre-warm and rolling canary — propose 2025-02-20.

Notes for the playbook (rules-of-thumb we can ship to them):
- Prefer short system prompts; use external storage for long user history and only include summarized vector context when needed.
- Use deterministic reranker for ID lookups: chain-of-trust pattern (LLM->DB lookup->verify) to reduce hallucination risk.
- Token budget enforcement: reject or truncate inputs over 3k tokens client-side and return a standard 'needs-summary' response.

Quick example prompt rewrite (before/after):
- BEFORE: "User: here's transaction 3f1c9a3b-9dfe-4f3a-... full JSON dump"
- AFTER: "User: transaction ID TX-7a9f, summary: payment for invoice 4321 (amount masked)"

Open risks / unanswered:
- Quality delta after int8 quantization for their medical reasoning tasks — need eval thresholds.
- Legal on log retention with peered VPC+managed control plane (legal consult).

Appendix: quick checklist for Private deploy baseline config (to include in draft):
- VPC peering established? (yes/no)
- KMS/HSM keys registered? (yes/no)
- Prefix cache enabled? (yes/no)
- Reserved burst pool configured? (yes/no)
- Token-level telemetry hooks installed? (yes/no)

End of capture. Keep this doc minimal and iterated — will make a cleaned handoff doc after Maya's cost analysis.

-- Ethan
